presets.title: Spike Tunnel
presets.summary: Everything at once: per-frame colour and zoom, per-vertex zoom and rotation, a thick additive circle wave, video echo and an outer border.

presets.title: Mode 0: Circle
presets.summary: nWaveMode 0 bends the waveform into a ring. A slight zoom pushes each old frame outward, so the rings spread.

presets.title: Mode 1: Radial Scope
presets.summary: nWaveMode 1: the right channel sets each point's distance from the centre and the left its angle, so the wave swirls around a ring.

presets.title: Mode 2: XY Scope
presets.summary: nWaveMode 2 plots the left channel against the right, like an oscilloscope in X-Y mode, faintly. Mono sound is a diagonal line; stereo opens it up.

presets.title: Mode 3: XY Scope, Treble
presets.summary: nWaveMode 3 is the X-Y scope again, but treble sets its brightness: it flares on hi-hats and cymbals.

presets.title: Mode 4: Momentum Line
presets.summary: nWaveMode 4 draws a horizontal line whose points carry momentum from their neighbours, so it ripples like a rope. wave_mystery sets how much.

presets.title: Mode 5: Rotating Products
presets.summary: nWaveMode 5 multiplies the channels together into a slowly rotating knot.

presets.title: Mode 6: Angled Line
presets.summary: nWaveMode 6 draws a line across the screen at an angle set by wave_mystery. dy moves every frame up the screen, so the history scrolls like a waterfall.

presets.title: Mode 7: Stereo Lines
presets.summary: nWaveMode 7 draws the left channel above and the right below; wave_y sets the gap. sx above 1 stretches old frames sideways.

presets.title: Dot Spiral
presets.summary: bWaveDots draws the circle wave as dots. Zoom and rotation turn the old dots into a spiral.

presets.title: Custom Wave: Spiral
presets.summary: A custom wave's per-point code places each of its samples. Here sample (0 to 1 along the wave) winds them into a spiral, and the audio in value1 makes it bristle.

presets.title: Custom Wave: Spectrum
presets.summary: bSpectrum gives a custom wave the frequency spectrum instead of the waveform: low notes on the left, high on the right. Two waves draw the left and right channels as mirrored bars of light.

presets.title: Custom Wave: Dots
presets.summary: bUseDots draws a custom wave's samples as points. Per-frame code sets t1, which every per-point run then reads.

presets.title: Shapes
presets.summary: Custom shapes are filled polygons with a centre colour, an edge colour and an outline. Here a hexagon breathes with the bass and a triangle spins with the treble.

presets.title: Shape Instances
presets.summary: num_inst draws a shape many times per frame; instance counts them so each copy can go somewhere else. Twenty-four copies of one shape make this ring.

presets.title: Textured Shape
presets.summary: A textured shape is filled with the previous frame. Turning its texture (tex_ang) and zooming into it (tex_zoom) folds the image back on itself.

presets.title: Motion Vectors
presets.summary: Motion vectors draw a grid of short lines showing where the warp is pulling each part of the image from. mv_x and mv_y set the grid, mv_l the length.

presets.title: Darken Centre
presets.summary: bDarkenCenter draws a faint dark spot in the middle every frame, so a zooming preset doesn't white out at its centre.

presets.title: Zoom
presets.summary: zoom above 1 magnifies the previous frame every frame, so everything flows outward. Here the bass drives it.

presets.title: Zoom Exponent
presets.summary: fZoomExponent bends the zoom by distance from the centre. Below 1 the middle races outward; above 1 the edges do. It sweeps slowly here.

presets.title: Rotation
presets.summary: rot turns the previous frame about (cx, cy) every frame. The centre wanders, so the spin swirls.

presets.title: Warp
presets.summary: warp distorts the frame with MilkDrop's animated sine field. fWarpScale sets the size of its swirls and fWarpAnimSpeed their speed.

presets.title: Stretch
presets.summary: sx and sy scale the previous frame horizontally and vertically. Here they take turns.

presets.title: Drift and Wrap
presets.summary: dx and dy slide the frame a little every frame. With bTexWrap on, whatever leaves one edge comes back on the other.

presets.title: Ripples
presets.summary: per_pixel code runs for every point of the warp mesh. Zoom depends on rad, the distance from the centre, so rings travel outward.

presets.title: Swirl
presets.summary: Rotation that falls off with distance from the centre (rot depends on rad) twists the frame into a whirlpool.

presets.title: Petals
presets.summary: ang is each point's angle around the centre. Zoom that varies with ang pushes the image out in six petals.

presets.title: Video Echo
presets.summary: fVideoEchoAlpha blends a zoomed copy over the image and nVideoEchoOrientation mirrors it. The mirroring changes every 5 seconds.

presets.title: Solarize
presets.summary: bSolarize folds bright colours back down, so the brightest parts turn dark.

presets.title: Invert
presets.summary: bInvert flips every colour: black becomes white.

presets.title: Brighten
presets.summary: bBrighten takes the square root of each colour, lifting the dim trails.

presets.title: Darken
presets.summary: bDarken squares each colour: dim trails sink away and only the brightest lines stay.

presets.title: Gamma
presets.summary: fGammaAdj multiplies the brightness of the final image. The bass drives it here.

presets.title: Borders
presets.summary: ob_ and ib_ draw an outer and an inner border every frame. Zooming out pulls the old ones inward into a tunnel of frames.

presets.title: Warp Shader: Liquid
presets.summary: A MilkDrop 2 warp shader replaces the fixed warp. Here each pixel samples the previous frame at an offset read from a smooth noise texture that drifts, so the image flows like liquid.

presets.title: Composite Shader: Palette
presets.summary: A composite shader decides how the feedback image reaches the screen without changing what feeds back. This one maps brightness onto a cycling cosine palette.

presets.title: Blur: Glow
presets.summary: MilkDrop 2 keeps three blurred copies of each frame for shaders to read. Adding GetBlur1 and GetBlur2 back onto the image gives it a soft glow.

presets.title: Noise Textures
presets.summary: Shaders get MilkDrop's noise textures: 2D in three smoothnesses, and 3D volumes. Here a slice through the 3D noise, moving through time, tints and pushes the image.

presets.title: Composite Shader: Kaleidoscope
presets.summary: Mirroring the screen coordinates in the composite folds whatever the preset draws into eight-way symmetry, without touching the feedback underneath.

presets.title: Composite Shader: Edges
presets.summary: texsize gives a shader the size of a pixel, so it can compare neighbours. The difference between them outlines every edge in neon.

presets.title: Bass, Mid, Treble
presets.summary: bass, mid and treb are the band levels, where 1 is average. Bass sets the wave's red, mid its green and treble its blue; bass_att drives the zoom.

presets.title: Beat Flash
presets.summary: Per-frame code can react to beats: when the bass jumps above its running average, the border flashes and the image kicks outward.
